title: Northern
summary: NORTH'ERN, adjective 1. Being in the north, or nearer to that point than to the east or west. 2. In a direction towards the north, or a point near it; as, to steer a northern course.

inlines.v: NORTH'ERN, adjective 1. Being in the north, or nearer to that point than to the east or west. 2. In a direction towards the north, or a point near it; as, to steer a northern course.
